title: District Four
description: Deep grooving crazy big percussion. Super danceable! High energy, without every getting the way. Useful for tech videos, badass characters, or general listenings! The download comes with all the parts separated out as well as a bonus track at 165 beats per minute (slightly slower and even deeper grooving!).

title: Dream Culture
description: Dreamy watery piano bits over a tight percussion with some reverse effects to add to the dreamlike state of things.

title: Cipher
description: I've been told this is R&B, but could be a few other things. It is certainly pretty neat. Warning: Very sticky hook.

title: Cold Funk
instruments: Guitar, Bass, Drum Kit, Electric Piano, Bells
description: A calming rock piece.  Repeated guitar chords as well as bass throughout.  Very light use of bells.  Great for looping if needed.
